item.hellfire.throw_hint: Hold use to charge, then release to throw. Not consumed.
item.hellfire.missile_strike.tooltip: Thrown red flare. A red beam marks the spot and a missile comes down for one large explosion.
item.hellfire.nuclear_strike.tooltip: Thrown yellow flare. A bomber flies over and drops one nuclear bomb. Then about a minute of radiation.
item.hellfire.napalm_strike.tooltip: Thrown orange flare. Same bombing run as the blue flare, and it sets the ground on fire.
item.hellfire.bombing_run.tooltip: Thrown blue flare. A plane drops a short line of bombs.
item.hellfire.aa_platform.tooltip: Place it. It locks a green box onto airborne targets and shoots them down. It will not shoot the player who placed it.
